name: macropus-giganteus
brief: Macropus giganteus Shaw, 1790 — Eastern Grey Kangaroo hypermedia species repository (South-Eastern Australia corridor). ECO-WP-11A covers ontological, UBERON anatomical, saltatorial/pentapedal biomechanical, allometric, ethological, and biocultural provenance; ECO-WP-11B will produce the 3-layer .vibe CAD and .hmc distribution.
